key_insight: REE benchmarks autonomous scientific research through iterative improvement, with two evaluated agents outperforming expert solutions on more than 80% of problems.
engineering_relevance: REE offers a shared framework for evaluating whether research agents can improve working scientific solutions under a fixed time budget.
method: Use 100 expert-reviewed, open-ended problems across five scientific areas and 23 domains.
Give agents up to 12 hours to iteratively improve a working starter solution.
Score improvements against established expert solutions evaluated under comparable conditions.
evidence_signal: Among four frontier agents evaluated, Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol beat expert solutions on 86% and 81% of problems, respectively, surpassing them within two hours on average.
watch_item: Benchmark gains should not be equated with novel discoveries: the best solutions mostly tailored or combined established methods.
paper_title: REE: A Scientific Research Entrance Exam for AI Agents
